description: Call this FIRST before any other tool for this provider. Create a Shinhan easy-inquiry session from a registered ID/password account link. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 사업자 유형: 개인사업자 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple connections for the same provider.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
